newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Gresik down on talk of weak Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Gresik down on talk of weak Q1 results.

text.p: Indonesian cement maker PT Semen Gresik was down about five percent in early afternoon trade on Monday on perceptions that its first quarter earnings were likely to be below market expectations, brokers said.
At 0655 GMT, Gresik was down 275 rupiah at 5,300 rupiah with about 1.4 million shares changing hands.
Shares of Semen Gresik were weak last week on market talk that its first quarter earnings would be poor.
On Thursday, it closed 25 rupiah lower at 5,875 rupiah and on Friday it was down 300 rupiah to close at 5,575 rupiah on heavy selling, brokers said.
